alert: decypharr is serving DEAD debrid links
description: decypharr's WebDAV layer failed to stream a file — the debrid link behind a symlink is dead and re-insert is failing. The arrs see these as I/O errors and their imports stall; Plex playback of the affected items dies too.

filter.expression: service.name = 'decypharr' AND severity_text = 'ERROR' AND body CONTAINS 'Failed to stream'

annotations.summary: decypharr can't stream: dead debrid link behind a symlink
annotations.description: The log line names the file and torrent id. Delete + re-add that torrent in decypharr; if it says "can't retry re-insert", repair will NOT fix it.
